identification: Carved white marble wall basin with grey veining: oval bowl, two rounded lugs at the front, flat back plate for wall mounting. Form of an Ottoman/Turkish hammam basin (kurna) or sacristy-style wall sink. Looks fairly clean and pale in the photos (the cloud scan's staining and rust looks minor: one small rust mark inside bowl in photo 2). Size not given (looks about 60-70 cm wide). Estimate 200-300, no bids yet.
